s01_start.rationale: Face reads at once (grin, cap, moustache) and the hero is in frame at 0 s, but the line is 'He sawed' and there is no saw, no rail and no train. The ground is a bare grey plane and the walls are a blurred generic checker block, so this could be any wall. Feet planted with a contact shadow is good. Hands hang limp and empty, no strange act shown.
s01_start.fix: Put a handsaw in his hand mid-stroke across a rail head on a visible track that leads into frame, with a steel-sparks effect; keep the head above the caption.

s01_end.rationale: Stronger acting (sunglasses, hammer raised, sparkle) and a held prop in a hand. But the word is 'a railroad' and the rail is only a faint line at the bottom edge, so the noun is not clearly visible. He holds a hammer where the line is about sawing, and the shot is a mid-size centred character in front of a blurred wall.
s01_end.fix: Lower the aim so two rails and ties are big in the foreground leading to the train, and give him the saw or the rail itself; the hammer is not needed.

s02_start.rationale: Eyes-closed deadpan on '39 feet.' is a clear character beat, but nothing shows 39 feet: no measuring tape, no sign, no number. The muted viewer cannot tell what changed. Set is the same blurred wall and a green blob with no train detail, and the framing is the same medium whole-body-on-centre as before.
s02_start.fix: Add a tape measure or ruler stretched along the rail with a big readable '39' card in his hand; shift to a low wide angle so the wall towers above him.

s02_end.rationale: Winking, one finger up for 'two', a good specific expression with a legible silhouette. But the number is only implied by one raised finger that is almost hidden behind the cap edge, and the background is unchanged, so it reads as a repeat of the previous panel. The green object on the left is a featureless shape and does not read as a train.
s02_end.fix: Raise the fist higher in clear air beside the head with two fingers up, and show two physical things (two rails or two cars) beside him; add the locomotive's face, wheels and lamp.

s03_start.rationale: Camera leaves him for the world, which fits the camera idea, but the frame is a heavily blurred diagonal of grey beams, a lattice and an orange block. Rail, canyon and void do not read at a glance, and the word 'railroad' sits over a muddy block. It reads as a failed shot. No character, no focal point, and the beam is a plain grey box.
s03_start.fix: Lower and straighten the camera so two clean rails with ties converge to the canyon edge, reduce blur, and put the engineer small in the lower third for scale.

s03_end.rationale: Almost the same abstract geometry as the prior panel with a different crop. 'so deep' is not shown: no visible depth cue and no sense of a drop. The brown slab and orange floor are dark, flat and unreadable, and the grey beam is a plain box with no details. Fails the phone-size read.
s03_end.fix: Tilt the camera over the lip to look straight down at a long vertical wall with a tiny train or figure far below, using clear atmospheric haze and a sharp rail in front.

s04_start.rationale: The canyon wall now reads as a gap with a ladder or lattice, a stronger sense of height and scale, but it is still a blurred abstract view with no story object. 'gets' carries no noun, no person and no rail. Blue void is a flat gradient.
s04_start.fix: Keep this low angle but sharpen the rail in the foreground and add one story detail: a tiny train or figure on the rail far down, with a cartoon effect such as dust or wind.

s04_end.rationale: Visually identical to s04_start (frames 297 and 298), so the pair gives no start and end progression. The shot has no move and no change, and the film ends without a loop back to his face.
s04_end.fix: Give s04 a real end rest: continue the move over the void to a different framing, ideally ending on the engineer's face or a canyon reveal so the end differs from the start and loops to panel one.

film_level.notes: Opening shows the hero within 0 s but not the strange act: no saw, no rail and no train are visible. Panels 1-4 are the same medium centred character on the same blurred orange wall (a flat limited world), then panels 5-8 are blurred abstract geometry with no face. Named nouns (saw, railroad, 39 feet, two, deep) are mostly not visible even though the plan tool says 0 are missing; the plan trusts labels. The camera idea (long cut flowing out over the void) is only partly visible and the last two panels are duplicates. Hero moments are weak; the strongest panels are s01_end and s02_end and the turn and payoff are the weakest. One place, one light, and the bodies lack props, so Hard Rule 2 caps these panels around 6.

studio_director.note: Not ready for CB. No panel reaches 8.5, and the best is 6.5. Rebuild the set (readable rails, ties, train, canyon edge with real detail), put the nouns the captions name on screen (saw, tape and numbers, rails), reduce the blur so the world panels read at 360 px, and make s04 start and end differ.
